entries.text: The Write Primitives bulk-load operations now run natively on SingleStore with LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE: CSV, delimited, quoted, NULL, date-format, bad-row skipping, column subset, transformation, multi-file, append, replace and upsert loads, plus gzip, bzip2, zstd and Parquet variants that are decompressed or converted to a local load file inside the timed operation.
